headline: Boeing Halts 777 Freighter Production for Two Months Over Supplier Dispute
summary: Boeing has halted assembly of its 777 freighter aircraft for two months following an unresolved dispute with a key supplier, according to industry sources.
why: Boeing is one of the world's two major aerospace manufacturers. Disruptions to long-haul freighter production threaten aircraft delivery timetables and commercial airline supply chains.

impacts.name: Boeing Co
impacts.why: A two-month production halt delays customer deliveries and risks aircraft revenue deferrals.
